response.sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_transaction_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM account AS a JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.amount >= 2400 AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC LIMIT 10;
